scene noonsky
It’s been kind of a while since I’ve just aimlessly wandered around the part of the city where Io’s bathhouse is.

And the reason I mention that now is that, upon coming here with the specific goal in mind of meeting up with Io, I realized that I was once again neglecting this apparent hidden desire of mine to just sort of wander around and do nothing.

You’d think that being essentially unemployed now would be conducive to that and, to some extent, I’m sure you’re right. But there are choices I make every single day that do naught but detract from this and today is no exception.
But what if I were to forgo Io entirely and just do laps around her block instead? Counting the cracks in the sidewalk and stepping on every one so as to grind my mother’s corpse to dust.
Do you think the girl with green hair would notice me? And if so, how many laps would it take?
If so, would she be proud of my newfound occupation as a corpse mangler?
Have I stolen this job out from under her feet?
Okay. That’s enough of that.
scene iosenseiothers1
: Oh, Sensei! Hey. Feel like it’s been a while since I’ve seen you over here.
: What were you up to today? How’d you wind up in my neck of the woods?
: Well, the initial intention was to come see you. But then I got caught up in a brief inner-monologue about corpse mutilation and started walking around in circles instead.
: And then wound up here once you realized you were essentially thinking about nothing and started to feel like you were wasting your day?
: Yeah, you know how it is.
: Sure do. But that’s fine by me because now we get to waste away together. Unless you’re here to tell me to die or something.
: I wouldn’t come all the way over here to tell you that, Io. I’d just text you.
: Just one more reason to keep my phone permanently on silent then.
scene iosenseiothers2
: You’re not meeting up with anybody, are you? Because context makes me think you’re not, but I’m instinctively obligated to ask due to self-esteem issues and an unwanted phobia of abandonment.
: I’m actually here to buy the place.
: Nice. Can I get Sundays off then? It’s American football season and Sunday Night Football starts at like 8:00 AM here. I can’t watch it without being tired for the rest of the day.
: Graduating from baseball?
: No. I just like watching people get hurt because I am a bad person. Football’s kind of boring as a sport to be honest. Way slower than baseball.
: Really? I always thought it was the other way around.
: Could be if they didn’t have to stop the clock for some sort of injury every other drive. Guess that’s the price I have to pay for secondhand masochism, though.
: Gotcha. Well, I’m out of sports-related dialogue and would like to swap conversation topics now.
scene iosenseiothers3
: Are you not here to use the bath today? We’re just gonna hang out?
: When have I ever come here to use the bath and not talk to you?
: All the time. Never alone, though. But I’ve always expected that to change since I can’t fathom wanting to be around Ami every hour of the day.
: Oh, also, can you tell her to stop getting gay with Uta? I don’t want to keep hearing about it.
scene iosenseiothers4
: Sure, I’ll- wait, what?
: いらっしゃいませ 。
: Hello, four ple- OH MY GOD!
scene iosenseiothers5
: A MAN! THAT’S A MAN! GET HIM!
: Ara ara...So rare nowadays. The chances of him being single are rather slim, no?
: Like I care about that! It’s been years since I’ve gotten any action! I need to jump at every single opportunity I get!
: Aren’t you over-exaggerating, Akina? We see men all the time. They’re just a little more rare now that-
: Not HOT ones!
: Oh. Yeah, okay.
: All we get are old people! And rich people who’d never sleep with a lower middle class salarywoman like me!
: Quick, give him more of your back story. It might persuade him to sleep with you.
scene iosenseiothers6
: Akina Ando. Twenty-nine years old. Four total partners. When I was twelve, I was hit by a motorcycle and needed to get a plate installed in my leg. My favorite foods are okonomiyaki and Pepero.
: No flirting in the lobby, please. Or anywhere.
: Uhh-
: Don’t listen to her. You and me? We were meant for each other. I can feel it. Now all that’s left is for me to feel you.
: Give it a rest, Akina. You’re probably hitting on him in front of his little sister right now.
scene iosenseiothers7
: Io, what do I do?
: Beats me, Onii-sama. I can’t prevent you from following your heart. Just know that you will be breaking mine in the process.
: Aww...I’m rooting for them now. Sorry, Akina.
: Man-meat. Look at me. Look into my eyes.
scene iosenseiothers8
: Man-meat?
: You. Me. Bath. And a throat so deep you could get lost in it. Sound good?
: That’s...uhh...
scene iosenseiothers9
: I’m gay.
: That’s fine. You don’t have to call me after. Just let me use your body for a little while.
: I think that was a rejection, Akina.
: If you’re so gay, tell me what docking feels like.
: Uhh...good?
: I’m convinced. Come on, Akina. I’ll help you update your Tinder profile.
scene iosenseiothers10
: That’s not going to help when the bank of available men in Kumon-mi is even emptier than my lower-middle class wallet! Give me that cock, gay boy!
: Sorry, but if you guys aren’t going to pay, I’m going to have to call the police.
: CALL THEM! THEY MIGHT BE MEN! I’M REQUESTING A FULL CAVITY SEARCH WHEN THEY GET HERE! THERE’S A BOMB IN MY VAGINA AND ONLY A FAT COCK CAN DEFUSE IT!
scene iosenseiothers11
: Akina! Bad girl! Come!
: S...Sorry about her...She gets like this whenever there’s a full moon...
: This should cover admission for four, right? Oh, and I have a punch card. If you could-
: Not a chance.
: Yeah...that’s fair.
scene iosenseiothers12
scene iosenseiothers13
: So anyway, football.
: Io, what just happened?
scene iosenseiothers14
: What, those girls? They come here all the time and stay for hours. They were probably just surprised to see you standing there all Sensei-like and stuff.
: I’m surprised you didn’t follow them. They seem like what you’d call “conventionally attractive.” That one girl would probably pay you too. Even with her lower-middle class salary.
: I prefer girls with character models, personally.
scene iosenseiothers15
: Huh. Yeah, I guess they did seem a little monochromatic now that you mention it. Am I not like that?
: No. Almost, though. You are very green in most cases. And I’d say it works for you, but you’d probably just say I’m only being nice or something.
: Do you even have the moral propensity to be that nice to someone so clearly undeserving of praise? What’s your real end goal here, Sensei?
: To find a future where Io Ichimonji can be happy with herself, as unlikely as that seems.
scene iosenseiothers16

: Aww, Sensei. It’s times like this where I wish my disdain for other females didn’t inhibit my desire to see this as a cute gesture rather than you just choosing to not follow a bunch of annoying strumpets into the women’s bath for group sex.
: Strumpets? Are you three-hundred years old?
scene iosenseiothers17
: No, but it really feels like I am sometimes, you know? What with all the medications, the hard candy I keep at my bedside, and the fact that I use a bow and arrow on a weekly basis.
: That last one seems like more of a time period thing and not something I’d associate with senior citizens. But go off, I guess.
scene iosenseiothers18
: Nah, I won’t subject you to that. Not after you’ve already lowered your value by approximately 50%% after kissing me.
: Shouldn’t you be sticking to your regular age group instead of locking lips with your elders and expanding the dating bank?
: Age groups are for suckers and like half of my identity is built around that. What really sucks is that the other half is built upon refusing and questioning it.
scene iosenseiothers19
: Lucky. I built my identity around the dumpster behind the bathhouse and now I’m too sad and gross to try and change it.
: Maybe we can increase your value by kissing more then?
: Are you sure you want to waste such cute lines on me when you have Uta mentally humping you all day long now? Save that stuff for her, Sensei. All I need is...
scene iosenseiothers20
: Well, basically all of the attention you have for the rest of forever.
scene iosenseiothers21
: But all I deserve is maybe a pat on the head once a month. Or a hug every two. Whichever’s easier for you.
: I’ll just keep kissing you, if that’s okay. That’s the closest I’ve come to making you happy so far. Though, it remains to be seen whether that was really me or just the mysterious hole.
scene iosenseiothers22
: Right! The hole! I have hole-related news for you!
: May I burden you once more with my incessant annoyances, Sensei? I promise it will be the last time until approximately five minutes from now when I inevitably do it again.
: Sure. It’ll be nice getting hole-related news that doesn’t involve a girl’s medical records or the damage I inflicted upon her.
: RIP Miku. Just not really because she is involved with this news as well!
: Oh no. Did the wounds reopen?
scene iosenseiothers23
: Gross! But no. Uta, Miku and I made plans to go spelunking again this weekend so they can finally see it. And I was wondering if you would want to come as well?
: Has Miku finally annoyed you to the point where you feel the need to throw her down a bottomless pit?
: No, but I can’t guarantee that isn’t what Uta and Miku plan to do with me once we get there.
: So you want me to come and act as your bodyguard or something?
: Or so I can say goodbye while falling to my death. Whichever one winds up feeling right, I guess.
: Just out of curiosity, what do you hope to find down there?
scene iosenseiothers24
: I don’t know. Hole stuff? It’s just cool. I want to go look at the cool thing again. And you’re cool too, so I want you to go look at the cool thing with me. I think that’d be cool.
: Cool.
scene iosenseiothers25
: Right?!
: Any chance I could bring someone else along if I say yes?
scene iosenseiothers26
: Uhh...who? Because you know I don’t like a good 90%% of the class. But if there’s someone you know who just...really likes tunnels for some reason-
: It’s not like that. I just...well, let’s say I’m part of a club. Like an...occult club, I guess. That investigates the mysteries of Kumon-mi.
: Why are you fucking with me? Just turn down the invitation if you don’t want to come. I promise I’ll only dwell on it until something else bad happens.
: I’m only partially fucking with you, Io. And even that’s just because the truth would sound even more ridiculous.
: This “club” of yours then — who’s in it?
: Makoto and Ayane are the two I’d want to bring. But if Maya, Yumi, and Nodoka could also come-
scene iosenseiothers27
: You’re turning this into an entire adventuring party. I was willing to compromise with maybe one, but I’d rather just stay behind entirely if you’re bringing that many.
: I mean, I don’t have to. I was just thinking it might be a good place for our next, uhh...club meeting?
scene iosenseiothers28
: On second thought, just forget I said anything.
: Io, I-
: No, it’s fine, Sensei. Really. Now that I think about it, dragging you along when Uta and Miku are going to be there is practically asking for them to just not focus at all in the first place.
: I mean, if “focus” is what you want out of your partners, you picked probably the two worst girls I can think of.
: I know. But that gets like ten times worse once you’re factored in as well, so...
: Maybe we can go on another trip later on. Once I figure out more. Where I allow you to bring one of your “clubmates.”
: Then, I’ll talk to Ayane about-
scene iosenseiothers29
: Makoto. Not Ayane.
: She’s the one I can tolerate the most out of that group. You bring Nodoka anywhere near me and I can promise you she’s going in the hole.
: Okay...Makoto it is then. But be careful, okay? That tunnel was huge and I don’t want you girls getting lost down there.
: We’ll be fine, I promise. I’ve gone down a few times on my own since you and I found it and I haven’t gotten lost once.
: Famous last words, Io. You’ve basically just sealed your fate. This will be the last talk we ever have.
scene iosenseiothers30
: Why have it here when there’s an entire bath completely vacant then? That’s a much more relaxing place to close the chapter on my existence, isn’t it?
: Probably because you hate all forms of nudity and have only been roped into this job out of necessity for shelter and money.
: Does just no one remember swimsuits exist? Obviously I’m not going to get naked. I have to wait until all the other girls leave to even use the locker room at school.
: Your existence makes me so sad. I’m not taking a bath with a swimsuit on, though.
: That just means you’re human, I think. Also, that’s fine. I’ve seen your penis plenty of times, remember?
if iosex == True:
: Even up close once! But that, just like my living situation, was also out of necessity.
: Okay, hold on. That was-
: Something neither one of us looks back on fondly, right? Which means it won’t happen again.
: Well...yeah. I wouldn’t want to put you through that again. But I also wouldn’t want to evoke any bad memories by putting you in a similar situation.
: You’re in luck then! Because I have so many terrible memories that having sex with you is almost a good one by comparison!
: Again, your existence makes me so extremely sad.
scene iosenseiothers31
: Come on. I’ll wash your back for you. I was about to close up shop anyway. The girls in the women’s bath can let themselves out.
: I don’t know...it still seems like a bad idea. Especially when I already had to stop you from venturing out of your comfort zone the last time you brought a game to my house.
: Are you going to walk on eggshells around me forever now then? Is that what’s going on?
: Is it really “walking on eggshells” to not let a girl who was sexually abused put her hands all over the naked body of an adult man?
: No. Just cowardice and a little self-distrust is all.
: Why are you being pushy about this? Isn’t this something we should be a little more careful about if we want to keep things normal?
: Yes and no. I don’t want to be normal. Normal is boring.
: But at the same time, it hurts being turned down. And I can’t not convince myself it’s because you’re disgusted by me. Are you?
: Of course not. But I...
: You what? Finish your sentence.
: I don’t want to become like the people who made us into who we are today.
scene iosenseiothers32
: Oh, Sensei...
: You already have.
$ iospring6 = True
$ io_love += 1
jump iospring7
else:
: I sure do. But a personal mission of mine is to prevent you from ever being close enough to touch it, and that is the exact situation you are asking me to partake in right now.
scene iosenseiothers29
: I’d be really offended by that if I wasn’t so averse to sexual contact.
: Io-
: Actually, strike that. I am still offended. You think I’m monochromatic after all, don’t you?
: I don’t. I think you’re insanely cute and that it would be hard for me to control myself in the scenario you’re inviting me to.
scene iosenseiothers32
: You controlled yourself when I was throwing myself at you, though. Wouldn’t that be harder?
: No, because the Io who was throwing herself at me looked nothing like the Io in front of me now. And it’s harder to not want you when you don’t look like you’re dying.
: How do you keep doing this?
: Doing...what? What did I do this time?
: Making me fall deeper in love with you.
: You really care about me...You’re not just faking it.
: There’s nothing I can give you in return, though. You won’t let me.
: I will if you figure something out to give me. I don’t want this, though.
: It’s just a bath, Sensei. I’m not telling you to destroy me this time. I just want to wash your back.
: I can reach my own back, Io. But thank you for the offer.
scene iosenseiothers33
: Can you at least kiss me again before leaving then? It’ll prevent me from having to throw myself over the counter to reach you.
scene black
: Hah...Yes, Io.
: I can kiss you again before leaving...
